subject: Q3 account check-in: health snapshot & priority escalations for Horizon Labs
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@horizonlabs.com>
Date: 2025-05-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 account check-in: health snapshot & priority escalations for Horizon Labs

Team,

Ahead of the QBR next Tuesday (May 20) I put together a short health snapshot and a prioritized list of renewal risks for Horizon. Attached are: Horizon_Q3_Health_Snapshot.xlsx (dashboard + one-pager) and renewal_risk_register_v3.csv (current risk lanes). Topline items I want to make sure we align on before the exec deck: 

- Usage trajectory: prod token consumption is down 12% QoQ but spike in inference latency on large context jobs (affects the data-science sandbox).
- Contract: base subscription renewal due 2025-07-01; expansion opportunity flagged for cross-tenant embeddings (estimated +25% ARR).
- Risk lane A: latency/availability incidents (2 incidents in last 45d) — customer wants stronger SLO guarantees and incident RCA artifacts.
- Risk lane B: cost surprise on high-traffic jobs — requesting a quarterly cost cap/commit conversation with finance.
- Customer ask for dedicated capacity trial for MLOps workloads — possibly convert to Dedicated offering.

Immediate asks:
1) Grace: can you draft an exec-facing 1-slide summary of the health snapshot and 3 suggested asks (SLA concession, Dedicated trial proposal, onboarding credit)? Aim for a slide that reads well in <2 minutes.
2) Neha: please validate the renewal timeline and update the risk register with today's latest finance exposure numbers.
3) Sara: can you confirm whether the Horizon execs will want to review technical RCA material live or prefer a post-QBR artifacts package?

I'm keeping the tone constructive — we have a strong case for expansion but we need clear mitigations for the latency incidents. I'd like to lock the exec slide by EOD Friday so Jordan (sales) can route the deck.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

Attachments: Horizon_Q3_Health_Snapshot.xlsx (xlsx), renewal_risk_register_v3.csv (csv)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@horizonlabs.com>
Date: 2025-05-14T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 account check-in: health snapshot & priority escalations for Horizon Labs

Thanks Michael — reviewed the snapshot and I have a first-pass slide. Key edits I recommend:

- Lead with the expansion opportunity (cross-tenant embeddings) as the positive headline; keep the latency incidents as the "risk/ask" section so execs see upside + mitigation.
- For the SLA ask, suggest: 99.9% P99 latency target + a 30-day pilot of Dedicated capacity for the 2 largest teams. Controls: pre-specified burst policy and telemetry access for Horizon.
- For the RCA, include a simplified timeline (date/time of incidents, root cause = transient GPU OOM on batch shard) and 3 mitigation steps taken (kernel-level patch, batching knob, autoscale config tweak).

I've uploaded my slide to the prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HorizonQ3Prep (file name: GRACE_Horizon_exec_slide_v1.pptx). I'll iterate on language once Neha confirms the financial exposure numbers.

On the subject of tone — I agree with keeping it constructive. I'll avoid technical deep-dives on the slide, but we should prepare a backup tech appendix in case they ask.

- Grace

Adding numeric validation and a few clarifications:

- Finance exposure (updated): projected overage risk without mitigation ~$78k next quarter (we capture this in renewal_risk_register_v3.csv, column: projected_overage_usd). I flagged this as Risk_B-Cost in the sheet.
- Renewal timeline: renewal notice sent 2025-05-01; formal commitment expected by 2025-07-01. Recommend we propose a 6-month pilot contract amendment that converts to Dedicated if usage > X tokens / month.
- RCA artifacts: I'll prepare a one-page appendix that has incident timeline + logs & confirmation of kernel patch. Allocate a CS engineer (Priya) to the tech appendix review.

I also recommend we include a clear ask to Horizon: an approval to run a 4-week Dedicated trial window with defined success metrics (p99 < 350ms on sandbox workloads, and no more than 1 scaled outage). If they approve, we can table the cost conversation into a subsequent commercial discussion.

I'll update the Drive assets and push a new version of renewal_risk_register_v3.csv with the cost column and a probability weight for each lane.

-Neha

Subject: Re: Q3 account check-in: health snapshot & priority escalations for Horizon Labs

Michael / Grace / Neha — thanks for the proactive prep. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Horizon execs want a short 10-minute run at the start of the QBR that focuses on value and a 5-minute technical appendix if needed. The Dedicated trial ask is fine but they need defined success metrics and a proposed credit structure.
- On the RCA: we prefer a short live Q&A during the QBR for the ops timeline, but we'll want the fuller logs and artifacts after the meeting.
- Confirmed: execs are available May 20 at 10:30am PT. Please send the finalized slide by EOD May 16 so I can circulate internally.

I'll also surface the cost cap conversation to our procurement lead — they may request a formal amendment or PO.

Best,
Sara Mendoza
Head of Data Platforms, Horizon Labs
sara.mendoza@horizonlabs.com
